{{Top}}
'''Trion''' was a very lethal gas often favored by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Trion gas was blue when not exposed to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. If exposed to oxygen, however, it was almost invisible making it very stealthy. [[IG-88B|IG-88]] was known to use trion gas.
